{"findings": [{"finding_id": "DD-1", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The httpx quickstart documents a response iterator as `iter_octets()`, but the Response class defines the binary iterator method as `iter_bytes()`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "httpx/docs/quickstart.md", "start_line": 346, "end_line": 348, "quote": ">>> with httpx.stream("GET", "https://www.example.com") as r:
...     for data in r.iter_octets():
...         print(data)"}, "code_citation": {"path": "httpx/httpx/_models.py", "start_line": 884, "end_line": 884, "quote": "def iter_bytes(self, chunk_size: int | None = None) -> typing.Iterator[bytes]:"}, "proposed_fix": "Replace `r.iter_octets()` with `r.iter_bytes()` in the quickstart example."}, {"finding_id": "DD-2", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The Click command pipelines section references a decorator named `build_pass_decorator`, but Click exports only `make_pass_decorator`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "click/docs/commands.md", "start_line": 182, "end_line": 183, "quote": "A straightforward way to do this is to use {func}`build_pass_decorator` to pass
a context object to each command."}, "code_citation": {"path": "click/src/click/decorators.py", "start_line": 51, "end_line": 51, "quote": "def make_pass_decorator("}, "proposed_fix": "Replace `{func}`build_pass_decorator`` with `{func}`make_pass_decorator``."}, {"finding_id": "DD-3", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The Werkzeug routing documentation says duplicate rules raise `DuplicateRouteError`, while the code defines the exception as `DuplicateRuleError`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "werkzeug/docs/routing.rst", "start_line": 98, "end_line": 98, "quote": "If a duplicate rule is added to a map, a :exc:`.DuplicateRouteError` will be raised."}, "code_citation": {"path": "werkzeug/src/werkzeug/routing/exceptions.py", "start_line": 17, "end_line": 17, "quote": "class DuplicateRuleError(Exception):"}, "proposed_fix": "Change `:exc:`.DuplicateRouteError`` to `:exc:`.DuplicateRuleError``."}, {"finding_id": "DD-4", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The structlog standard-library suggests a processor named `add_log_severity_number`, but the standard library module provides `add_log_level_number`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "structlog/docs/standard-library.md", "start_line": 104, "end_line": 104, "quote": "{func}`~structlog.stdlib.add_log_severity_number`:"}, "code_citation": {"path": "structlog/src/structlog/stdlib.py", "start_line": 848, "end_line": 848, "quote": "def add_log_level_number("}, "proposed_fix": "Replace `add_log_severity_number` with `add_log_level_number`."}, {"finding_id": "DD-5", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The Jinja API documentation refers to `PackageReader`, but the available loader class is `PackageLoader`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "jinja/docs/api.rst", "start_line": 242, "end_line": 242, "quote": "env = Environment(autoescape=select_autoescape(['html', 'htm', 'xml']),
                      loader=PackageLoader('mypackage'))"}, "code_citation": {"path": "jinja/src/jinja2/loaders.py", "start_line": 269, "end_line": 269, "quote": "class PackageLoader(RootLoader):"}, "proposed_fix": "Replace `PackageReader` with `PackageLoader` in the API documentation example."}, {"finding_id": "DD-6", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The Jinja API documentation documents a `Template` member `make_module`, but the implementation method is `create_module`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "jinja/docs/api.rst", "start_line": 179, "end_line": 179, "quote": ":members: module, make_module"}, "code_citation": {"path": "jinja/src/jinja2/environment.py", "start_line": 1386, "end_line": 1386, "quote": "def create_module("}, "proposed_fix": "Change `make_module` to `create_module` in the Template members list."}, {"finding_id": "DD-7", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The Jinja API documentation lists an autoclass member `draw_async`, but `Template` has no `draw_async` method.", "doc_citation": {"path": "jinja/docs/api.rst", "start_line": 214, "end_line": 214, "quote": ".. automethod:: draw_async([context])"}, "code_citation": {"path": "jinja/src/jinja2/environment.py", "start_line": 1294, "end_line": 1294, "quote": "async def render_async(self, *args: t.Any, **kwargs: t.Any) -> str:"}, "proposed_fix": "Remove the `draw_async` automethod entry; use `render_async` or `generate_async` instead."}, {"finding_id": "DD-8", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The Jinja API documentation refers to `MemcachedBytecodeMemo`, but the exported bytecode cache class is `MemcachedBytecodeCache`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "jinja/docs/api.rst", "start_line": 499, "end_line": 499, "quote": ".. autoclass:: jinja2.MemcachedBytecodeMemo"}, "code_citation": {"path": "jinja/src/jinja2/__init__.py", "start_line": 11, "end_line": 11, "quote": "from .bccache import MemcachedBytecodeCache as MemcachedBytecodeCache"}, "proposed_fix": "Replace `MemcachedBytecodeMemo` with `MemcachedBytecodeCache`."}, {"finding_id": "DD-9", "drift_kind": "name", "explanation": "The Jinja template documentation example imports `PackageReader`, but the public class is `PackageLoader`.", "doc_citation": {"path": "jinja/docs/templates.rst", "start_line": 242, "end_line": 242, "quote": "from jinja2 import Environment, PackageReader, select_autoescape"}, "code_citation": {"path": "jinja/src/jinja2/__init__.py", "start_line": 28, "end_line": 28, "quote": "from .loaders import PackageLoader as PackageLoader"}, "proposed_fix": "Replace `PackageReader` with `PackageLoader` in the template documentation example."}], "atlas_claims": []}
